_doc: Reviewed facts about v0.65.0 (tag commit 499779c6c2c0) that cmux-old.ts generate cannot read from the Swift source alone. skip: an "/api/" literal that is not a request to the cmux web origin. methods: the method when the source passes it in a variable. responses: the shape a hand-written (JSONSerialization) decoder needs, keys it reads with `guard ... else { throw }` are required, keys it reads with `as?` and a fallback are optional ("key?"). reads: a non-GET request that changes no state, replayed signed in with this body. shapeOnly: a GET never replayed signed in. fill: where the replay takes each path parameter (team = the agent's selected Stack team, vm = its first machine, publication = its first publication). Every entry must match the tag; generate fails on a stale one.
